name: k8s-dashboard
description: Kubernetes dashboard with React/Vite frontend and Node.js backend

scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix auth_server
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test server/src/**/*.test.ts && npm --prefix auth_server run test
scripts.check: node scripts/check-project.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm run test
